title: Training the next generation: how we invest in our technicians
description: Factory certifications, mentoring and a clear path from apprentice to master tech. Why our shop invests in training, and what it means for your uptime.
body:
Modern trucks are rolling computers, and keeping them on the road takes technicians who keep learning. That is why we invest in training at every level of the shop.

From apprentice to master tech

New technicians pair with senior mentors and work toward factory certifications on a clear schedule, with time on the clock for coursework.

What it means for you

Better-trained technicians diagnose faster and fix it right the first time, which means fewer comebacks and more days on the road.
